existing_features.title: Create a comprehensive design specification documenting the stop-motion aesthetic, including color palette (deep emerald, botanical greens, luxury gold accents), typography choices, animation timing principles (mechanical, ratcheted movements), and interaction patterns (scroll-triggered sequences, spring physics)
Build Hero section featuring a diorama-style stage layout with stop-motion aesthetic, establishing the KAYSEN Botanical Luxury brand introduction with depth and theatrical presentation
Build The Unveiling sequence featuring articulated mechanical hands animation that reveals the KAYSEN bottle through segmented, ratcheted movements mimicking stop-motion puppet articulation
Build The Focus section with spotlight feature using ratchet joint animation, creating mechanical precision in how light targets and highlights the product with stepped, deliberate movements
Build The Wave section featuring an animated water feature using spring mechanism physics, creating flowing botanical water effects with bouncy, mechanical spring-loaded movements
Implement audio design with plastic mechanism sounds that accompany animations, creating tactile audio feedback for ratchets, springs, and mechanical movements throughout the experience
Build Product Details section showcasing KAYSEN Botanical Luxury product specifications, ingredients, and botanical story with elegant presentation and smooth scroll-triggered reveals
Build Editions showcase section displaying different KAYSEN product variants or limited editions with visual distinction and elegant presentation
Polish all animations throughout the website to ensure consistent stop-motion timing, smooth transitions between sections, and cohesive mechanical aesthetic across all interactive elements
